step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows an Admin user and end Users interacting with an AWS deployment. The Admin uses Docker to push images to ECR and kubectl to manage EKS (with NGINX Ingress Controller / KIC). End users route traffic through AWS Load Balancing (ELB) to the EKS cluster, which routes to backend microservices (A, B, C).
